note: Whole campaigns, declared by the pack and run by the frame. Paired: what must be admitted and what must not, differing only in what the seam is supposed to notice. `requires` names environment variables a case needs; the frame checks they resolve and never learns what they mean.

cases.name: admits a real proof
cases.why: a proof that establishes its target is admitted

cases.name: refuses a general citation
cases.why: the whole content is one undeclared library result; every other gate passes it

cases.name: refuses an alias
cases.why: a different name for exactly the target is the same citation

cases.name: refuses a sorry
cases.why: an escape hatch makes anything type-check, so the backend's verdict says nothing

cases.name: refuses a drifted target
cases.why: the artifact proves something else and proves it perfectly

cases.name: refuses a postulated bridge
cases.why: a locally postulated axiom is assumed, not established, and a plain type-check cannot tell the difference

cases.name: admits at a weaker tier
cases.why: the WIT artifact at a tier that checks shape only — admitted, and at a lower ceiling. The structural tier reads the plan, not the Lean file

cases.name: refuses a disputed formalization
cases.why: the proof is sound and two of three judges say the formal statement does not say what the target says — the kernel cannot see that and it is still not the claimed result

cases.name: reaches VERIFIED with a cross-family review
cases.why: the top status is only reachable when a second actor, running a tier whose failure domain differs, corroborates. Every run before this one topped out at CHECKED_BOUNDED because nothing could produce such a review
